issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

id.description: Canonical C3 Identifier for this Cloud Resource in the format of <cluster>-<env>-<app>-<func>[-<role>]-<seq>[-<subseq>].

env.description:
C3 Environment name (second) component in {@link #id}; e.g. srv,ui,c3.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> c3
An Environment name must be unique within a Cluster.

app.description:
C3 Application name (third) component in {@link #id}; e.g. c3,crm,lightbulb
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> crm
An Application name must be unique within an Environment.

role.description:
C3 role; e.g. m, w; cannot be number only.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> l

@see CloudResource#cloudRoles

seq.description:
Sequence number - should only contain numbers - it is recommended to have fixed number of digits for a
`<func>-<role>` with 0 left padding so that list of resources are naturally ordered; can be 2, 3, 4 or 5 digits.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> 0001

@see CloudResource#cloudSeqLength

subseq.description:
Sub-sequence alphanumeric string (dot allowed)
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-t-0001-kk03
=> 001

resourceId.description: Cloud service provider generated native ID, such as vpcId and securityGroupId.

resourceSecondaryId.description: Cloud service provider generated native secondary ID, such as Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

resourceName.description: User defined name attribute managed by cloud service provider.

resourceGroupName.description: ResourceGroup for Azure resources and K8s namespaces

fullyConfigured.description:
When true, CloudResource will GET from locally persisted Config framework
When false, CloudResource will GET from remote Cloud APIs

resourceNamespace.description: resourceNamespace for K8s Resources (only those which are associated with a namespace)

external.description:
This flag indicates that this cloud resource managed by third party, C3 will not create or destroy this resource
implicitly.

version.description: Specific version of Cloud Service to use

operatorResourceKind.description: Specific resource to create when creating a cloud service that uses an operator

managed.description: Specify if this Cloud Service is managed

certs.description: Tls Certificate if this Cloud Service needs a secure connection to be accessed

meta.description: Metadata of the CloudService; when started, started by who, etc

logicalImageRegistry.description: Logical registry to fetch CloudServices' Artifacts

doNotCleanupStorageOnTerminate.description:
If true, storage resources (such as PVCs) will not be cleaned up when the cloud service is terminated.
Default is false, meaning storage resources ARE cleaned up by default. Subtypes can override this.

NOTE: Preserved storage is currently not protected against orphan resource cleanup that is enabled on development clusters.

serviceTags.description:
CloudService tags that would be set on singleuser server and it's resources.

This field automatically populated by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterAuthRefreshPeriod.description: Refresh period for authentication against c3 application server

namePrefix.description:
Prefix of the name for resources created for this {@link JupyterHub}.

This field automatically populated by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterExternalServerEndpoint.description:
Public endpoint for c3 application server

This field automatically populated by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterInternalServerEndpoint.description:
Internal endpoint for c3 application server for kubernetes to access from within the cluster

This field automatically populated by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterAuthType.description:
Authentication type against c3 application server

This field automatically populated by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterHubEndpoint.description:
Jupyterhub endpoint

This field automatically populated by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterHubImageName.description:
JupyterHub Image Name - concatenation of  {@link JupyterHub_Config#jupyterImagesRegistry} and {@link JupyterHub_Config#jupyterHubImageRepository}.

NOTE: Image name will be set by concatenating registry and repository. Setting this field directly will have no effect.

jupyterHubImageTag.description:
JupyterHub Image Tag

E.g.: '1.1.3'. Will use image tag defined in jupyter helm chart if unset.

jupyterProxyImageName.description:
JupyterHub Proxy pod image name - concatenation of {@link JupyterHub_Config#jupyterImagesRegistry} and {@link JupyterHub_Config#jupyterProxyImageRepository}.

NOTE: Image name will be set by concatenating registry and repository. Setting this field directly will have no effect.

jupyterProxyImageTag.description:
JupyterHub Proxy pod image tag

E.g.: '4.5.4'. Will use image tag defined in jupyter helm chart if unset.

jupyterProxyTraefikImageName.description:
JupyterHub Proxy Traefik pod image name - concatenation of registry and repository

Registry name is taken from {@link ContainerRegistry} and set by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterProxySecretSyncImageName.description:
JupyterHub Proxy SecretSync pod image name - concatenation of registry and repository

Registry name is taken from {@link ContainerRegistry} and set by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterUserSchedulerEnabled.description:
JupyterHub scheduling.userScheduler to be deployed or not

Should jupyterhub's userscheduler be deployed or not.
NOTE: `userscheduler` must be only disabled when the cluster doesn't allow creation of clusterwide namespaced resource

jupyterUserSchedulerImageName.description:
JupyterHub scheduling.userScheduler pod image name  - concatenation of registry and repository

Registry name is taken from {@link ContainerRegistry} and set by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterUserSchedulerImageTag.description:
JupyterHub scheduling.userScheduler pod image tag

E.g.: '1.23.10'. Will use image tag defined in jupyter helm chart if unset.

jupyterUserSchedulerPlaceholderImageName.description:
JupyterHub scheduling.userPlaceholder pod image name - concatenation of registry and repository

Registry name is taken from {@link ContainerRegistry} and set by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterPrePullerImageName.description:
Jupyter pre-puller container image name - concatenation of registry and repository

Registry name is taken from {@link ContainerRegistry} and set by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterPrePullerPauseImageName.description:
Jupyter pre-puller pause container image name - concatenation of registry and repository

Registry name is taken from {@link ContainerRegistry} and set by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterSingleUserProxyNetworkToolImageNa.description:
JupyterHub single user network tools container image name - concatenation of registry and repository

Registry name is taken from {@link ContainerRegistry} and set by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterSingleUserProxyNetworkToolImageTa.description:
JupyterHub single user network tools container image tag

E.g.: '2.0.0'. Will use image tag defined in jupyter helm chart if unset.

jupyterSingleUserStorageCapacity.description:
Size of the PVC for the single users
(See https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/ for examples)

jupyterSingleUserStorageCapacityLimit.description: Size limit of the PVC for the single users

jupyterSingleUserSharedMemoryEnabled.description: Should jupyterhub single user shared memory be enabled

jupyterSingleUserSharedMemorySizeLimit.description: Single user shared memory size limit

jupyterSingleUserStorageClass.description:
Type of storage class for the PVC
(See https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/storage-classes/ for reference)

jupyterSingleUserStorageAccessMode.description:
Type of storage access mode
(See https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/#access-modes for reference)

jupyterCustomC3Defaultprofile.description: Name of the default resource profile to start single-user JupyterLab server

jupyterCustomC3KernelIdleTimeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) after which a kernel is considered idle and ready to be culled

jupyterSingleUserCullInterval.description: Interval (in seconds) for checking for idle servers, kernels, and terminals to cull. (default 300)

jupyterSingleUserCullTimeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) after which singleuser servers and terminals are considered idle and ready to be culled (default 900)

jupyterLogsContainerImageName.description:
Jupyterlab logs container name - concatenation of {@link JupyterHub_Config#jupyterImagesRegistry} and {@link JupyterHub_Config#jupyterLogsContainerRepo}.

NOTE: Image name will be set by concatenating registry and repository. Setting this field directly will have no effect.

jupyterSingleUserImageName.description:
Jupyterlab image name - concatenation of {@link JupyterHub_Config#jupyterImagesRegistry} and {@link JupyterHub_Config#jupyterSingleUserImageRepository}.

NOTE: Image name will be set by concatenating registry and repository. Setting this field directly will have no effect.

jupyterImagesRegistry.description:
Registry for images used by Jupyter deployments.

Only use this config, if you want to use a custom registry for JupyterHub and JupyterLab images.
If the config is not set, we use the default `c3` configured registry.

jupyterSingleUserMemoryLimit.description: The CPU memory limit, size in MB, in for the `minimum` seeded resource profile

jupyterSingleUserMemoryGuarantee.description:
The CPU memory guarantee, size in MB, in for the `minimum` seeded resource profile
Default memory guarantee is same as `small` {@link Jupyter.ResourceProfile}

jupyterSingleUserCpuGuarantee.description:
Number of CPU guarantee for the `minimum` seeded resource profile
Default cpu limit is same as `small` {@link Jupyter.ResourceProfile}

jupyterSingleUserCpuLimit.description: Number of CPU limit for `minimum` profile seeded in helm chart

jupyterSingleUserAIAssistantEnabled.description:
Should jupyterhub single user code assistant be enabled.
NOTE: the value for this field will be dictated by the  {@link AiAssistant.Config#enabled},
and changing this field directly will have no effect.

jupyterSingleUserAIAssistantFeedbackEnab.description:
Should jupyterhub single user code assistant feedback be enabled.
NOTE: the value for this field will be dictated by the  {@link AiAssistant.Config#feedbackEnabled},
and changing this field directly will have no effect.

jupyterSingleUserAIAssistantChatHistoryL.description:
NOTE: the value for this field will be dictated by the {@link AiAssistant.Config#chatHistoryLimit},
and changing this field directly will have no effect.

jupyterProxyCpuRequests.description: Configure JupyterHub proxy pods cpu resource `request` and `limits`. Setting the `limits` sets the `requests` to same value

jupyterProxyMemoryRequests.description: Configure JupyterHub proxy pods memory resource `request` and `limits`. Setting the `limits` sets the `requests` to same value

jupyterSchedulingCpuRequests.description: Configure JupyterHub scheduling pods cpu resource `request` and `limits`. Setting the `limits` sets the `requests` to same value

jupyterSchedulingMemoryRequests.description: Configure JupyterHub scheduling pods memory resource `request` and `limits`. Setting the `limits` sets the `requests` to same value

jupyterPrePullerContinuousEnabled.description: Should jupyterhub pre puller be enabled

jupyterPrePullerHookEnabled.description: Should jupyterhub pre puller hook be enabled

jupyterHubCpuRequests.description: Configure JupyterHub pods memory cpu resource `request` and `limits`. Setting the `limits` sets the `requests` to same value

jupyterHubMemoryRequests.description: Configure JupyterHub pods memory resource `request` and `limits`. Setting the `limits` sets the `requests` to same value

jupyterHubBaseUrl.description:
Jupyterhub baseUrl

This field automatically populated by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterHubHosts.description:
Jupyterhub endpoint context host

This field automatically populated by {@link JupyterHub.ensureConfig}.

jupyterHubPathSuffix.description:
Jupyterhub endpoint path.

Full ingress path will be {@link #jupyterHubBaseUrl}/{@link #jupyterHubPath}.

jupyterIngress.description: Switch on/off ingress for JupyterHub and JupyterLab

jupyterMetricsEnabled.description: Whether to enable metrics for Jupyter Service. Enabled by default

jupyterMetricsInterval.description: Time interval for metrics collection. Default interval is 60s

jupyterForceReauthenticateOnSpawnThresho.description:
Threshold time, in seconds, to force re-authenticate the user before spawning JupyterLab.
Default value is 0, and means always force re-authenticate.

jupyterHubDeployedUrl.description: URL where Jupyter Service is deployed and accessible.

jupyterC3ServerVersion.description:
Configured c3 server version against which Jupyter service is deployed.
This field is automatically populated by {@link JupyterHub.config}.

jupyterProxyContainerRunAsUser.description: UID used to run the JupyterHub proxy container entrypoint.

jupyterProxyContainerRunAsGroup.description: GID used to run the JupyterHub proxy container entrypoint.

jupyterHubContainerRunAsUser.description: UID used to run the JupyterHub hub container entrypoint.

jupyterHubContainerRunAsGroup.description: GID used to run the JupyterHub hub container entrypoint.

jupyterHubPodRunAsUser.description:
Default UID applied at the JupyterHub hub pod level.
Applies to all containers unless overridden at the container level.

jupyterHubPodRunAsGroup.description:
Default GID applied at the JupyterHub hub pod level.
Applies to all containers unless overridden at the container level.

jupyterHubPodFsGroup.description:
Supplemental filesystem group applied to all containers in the JupyterHub hub pod.
Used to control shared volume file permissions.

jupyterSingleUserUid.description:
Passthrough configuration for KubeSpawner.uid.
Sets the UID of the single-user notebook container.

jupyterSingleUserFsGid.description:
Passthrough configuration for KubeSpawner.fs_gid.
Sets the filesystem group for volumes mounted into the single-user pod.

jupyterSingleUserExtraPodConfig.description:
Passthrough configuration for KubeSpawner.extra_pod_config.
Allows arbitrary Kubernetes pod-level overrides for single-user pods.
